enriched_description: Large household appliance for food storage at low temperatures, consisting of an insulated cabinet with one or more hinged doors. Standard models are rectangular, 150-180 cm tall, 60-90 cm wide, and 60-75 cm deep. Exterior is finished in painted steel, stainless steel, or colored enamel with a smooth, glossy surface. Interior contains adjustable wire or glass shelves, door bins, crisper drawers, and a freezer compartment (top, bottom, or side-by-side configuration). Door features a magnetic gasket seal and integrated handles or recessed grips. Distinguishing features include insulated cabinet construction, interior shelving system, and hinged door with magnetic seal.

Handheld electronic device for wirelessly operating machines or appliances from a distance. Rectangular bar-shaped body (12-20 cm long, 4-6 cm wide, 1.5-3 cm thick) constructed from molded plastic with a matte or slightly textured finish. Front face features an array of rubber or membrane buttons arranged in functional groups (power, volume, channel, navigation). Top end houses an infrared LED emitter visible as a small dark lens. Back includes a battery compartment cover. Button labels are printed, embossed, or backlit. Distinguishing features include button matrix layout, IR emitter window, and handheld ergonomic proportions.

Commercial building designed for food service and dining, characterized by a storefront entrance with signage, large display windows, and an interior dining area. Exterior features a facade with restaurant name signage, menu boards, and decorative elements reflecting cuisine type. Interior includes tables, chairs, booth seating, a service counter or bar, and ambient lighting. Kitchen area is visible through service windows or hidden behind swinging doors. Outdoor seating may include patio tables, umbrellas, and planters. Distinguishing features include dining furniture arrangement, food-service counter, menu displays, and commercial hospitality architecture.

Handgun featuring a rotating cylinder that holds multiple cartridges (typically 6 chambers). Overall length 20-30 cm, with a barrel length of 5-15 cm. Frame is constructed from blued steel, stainless steel, or alloy with a matte or polished finish. Cylinder rotates on a central axis, aligned with the barrel for each shot. Grip is checkered wood, rubber, or synthetic material for secure handling. Trigger guard encloses a single-action or double-action trigger mechanism. Front and rear sights are mounted on top of the barrel. Distinguishing features include visible rotating cylinder, exposed hammer, and multi-chamber ammunition configuration.

Shoulder-fired firearm with a long barrel (40-70 cm) featuring internal rifling (spiral grooves) that imparts spin to the projectile for accuracy. Overall length 90-120 cm. Stock is constructed from wood, synthetic polymer, or laminated composite, shaped to fit against the shoulder with a cheek rest. Barrel is blued steel or stainless with a front sight and rear sight or scope mounting rail. Action may be bolt-action, lever-action, semi-automatic, or pump-action. Magazine is internal or detachable. Distinguishing features include long rifled barrel, shoulder stock configuration, and precision sighting system.

Seating furniture mounted on two curved wooden or metal bands (rockers) that allow a gentle back-and-forth rocking motion. Frame consists of a seat, backrest, armrests, and legs connected to the curved rocker runners. Constructed from wood (oak, pine, walnut) with a stained, painted, or natural finish, or from molded plastic or wicker. Seat height is approximately 40-50 cm, overall height 90-120 cm. Rocker runners extend beyond the front and rear legs with a smooth arc profile. Distinguishing features include curved rocker runners, rocking motion capability, and traditional chair frame mounted on arcs.

Cooking appliance equipped with a motorized rotating spit for even roasting of meat. Countertop models are box-shaped (30-50 cm wide, 25-40 cm deep, 25-35 cm tall) with a glass door or open front revealing the interior cooking chamber. Spit is a horizontal metal rod with forks or prongs to secure the food, driven by an electric motor. Heating elements (electric coils or gas burners) are positioned above, below, or behind the spit. Drip tray collects rendered fat. Exterior is stainless steel or painted metal. Distinguishing features include rotating spit mechanism, enclosed cooking chamber, and integrated drip collection system.

Small block of vulcanized rubber or synthetic elastomer used for removing pencil marks from paper. Rectangular or cylindrical shape, typically 1-3 cm in each dimension. Surface is smooth, slightly matte, and flexible with a characteristic rubbery texture. Color is pink, white, gray, or blue. Pencil-mounted variants are small cylindrical caps fitted over the end of a wooden pencil, held by a metal ferrule band. Block erasers may have a paper wrapper or be unwrapped. Distinguishing features include small block geometry, rubbery flexible material, and friction-based mark-removal function.

Inflated prolate spheroid ball used in rugby, constructed from synthetic leather or rubber with a pebbled or dimpled surface texture for grip. Dimensions approximately 28-30 cm in length and 18-20 cm in width at the widest point. Surface features four panels stitched or bonded together with visible seam lines. Color is traditionally brown or white with possible stripe markings. Inflation valve is located at one end. Weight is 410-460 grams when inflated. Distinguishing features include elongated oval (prolate spheroid) geometry, four-panel construction, and textured grip surface.

Straight-edged measuring instrument consisting of a flat strip of wood, metal, or plastic with graduated markings along one or both edges. Standard length is 30 cm (12 inches) or 100 cm (1 meter), with width of 2-4 cm and thickness of 1-3 mm. Markings include millimeter, centimeter, and/or inch divisions with numerical labels at regular intervals. Surface is smooth with printed, etched, or engraved graduations. Material may be transparent (plastic), metallic (steel, aluminum), or wooden with a natural or painted finish. Distinguishing features include linear measurement graduations, straight reference edge, and elongated rectangular strip geometry.
